subject: Orazio Mazza

subject: Venerando Mazza (written Marza)
note: PIEDIMONTE ETNEO, Nati 1861 atto 201 (second volume of 1861, an_ua72407, image 13). THIS IS VENERANDO'S BIRTH. Checked against the image by the session (zoomed on the declaration, the parents' paragraph and the witnesses). Declared on 11 December 1861 by the father, SALVATORE MARZA (as written), 21, bracciale, living at Piedimonte: a baby boy born that day at ten o'clock in the house where they live, to LEONARDA PATANE, 24, living at Piedimonte, and the declarant; named VENERANDO. The parish priest returned the baptism note the same day: 'Venerando Marza'. Witnesses Rosario Greco, 40, bracciale, and Salvatore C... (the surname is not clear), 28, bracciale, both of Piedimonte; the declarant and the witnesses said they could not write. Received by Santo Coglitore (as read), acting assessor standing in for the mayor. No street is given. THE SURNAME IS WRITTEN MARZA throughout (the closing table, the act and the baptism line), the form the 1893 death act of his son also uses; the 1887 Linguaglossa marriage and the Piedimonte births of 1887 and 1888 write Mazza. Ages: the father 21 gives a birth about 1840; the mother 24, about 1837. Venerando was 25 at his marriage in September 1887 and 26 in November 1888, both right for a December 1861 birth. The Mazza Salvatore, 46, bracciante, who declared the infant Salvatore's death at Piedimonte in June 1887 (Morti 1887 atto 65) fits this father by age and trade, but nothing in either act says so: it is a lead, not a finding. UPDATE 11 Nov 2026: the parents' own marriage is now found (Piedimonte Matrimoni 1860 atto 30, 27 August 1860: Salvatore Mazza, 19, son of Mariano and Maria Catalano, and Leonarda Patane, 24, daughter of Alfio and Maria Sudero?), so the father is Salvatore Mazza born about 1841 (the 1861 act's 21 is a year or two high), and the Mazza Salvatore, 46, of the 1887 death acts is the same age; that he is the same man is still an inference, not stated in any act. subject: Mariano Mazza & Agata Catalano
note: PIEDIMONTE ETNEO, Matrimoni 1836 atto 17 (an_ua72256, image 35, the right page of the opening; Bourbon-era 'Atto della solenne promessa'). Checked against the image by the session (zoomed on the parties paragraph). MARIANO MAZZA, 30, son of IGNAZIO (the session reads 'Ignazio'; the 1836 table and an earlier reading wrote Orazio, so the father's name is NOT settled) and of GIUSEPPA PULVIRENTI (70); × AGATA CATALANO, 27, born at Macchia, daughter of the late CARLO CATALANO and of MARIA CARDILLO (60). Promise 7 September, celebrated 8 September 1836. WHY IT MATTERS: the 1860 acts (Matrimoni 1860 atti 30 and 31) name Mariano Mazza (52) and MARIA Catalano (59) as the parents of Salvatore and Venera, and Rosario's birth act of 1845 gives Mariano 36 and Maria Catalano 36. Mariano's age fits all three (30 in 1836, 36 in 1845, 52 in 1860), and Venera (23 in 1860, born about 1837) falls the year after this marriage. Mariano's own death act (Morti 1887 atto 10, 9 February 1887, aged 80, 'fu Orazio' and 'fu Polvirenti Giuseppa') calls his wife CATALANO AGATA, so the 1836 bride is still his wife fifty years later. The wife is AGATA here and in 1887 but MARIA in 1845, 1860 and 1871; her ages (27 in 1836 and 36 in 1845, both a birth about 1809; 59 in 1860) agree except for the last. This is a PROBABLE link (same man, a wife surnamed Catalano, a first child within a year), NOT a proved one: the two Christian names are unreconciled and no act says that Agata and Maria are one woman or that this Mariano is Rosario's father. The tree join is recorded in documented-additions.tsv as inferred. UPDATE 11 Nov 2026 (later): Salvatore's birth extract (Nati 1841 atto 15, 29 January 1841) and Venera's Linguaglossa baptism certificate (2 December 1837), both in the 1860 marriage bundle, name the mother as MARIA CATALANO and the father as Mariano Mazza (33 in 1841); so Mariano and Maria are one couple at Piedimonte and Linguaglossa from 1837, and the open question is only whether Maria is the Agata Catalano of this 1836 act. Not read: witnesses' names and signatures, the notification dates, the rest of the act outside the parties paragraph.

subject: Francesco Mazza & Giuseppa Fresta
note: GIARRE: Matrimoni 1866 ATTO 13 (an_ua80805, image 10 right page, continuing on image 11; margin heading 'Francesco Mazza e Giuseppa Fre?ta'), found by a delegated reader walking the register by its margin headings and re-zoomed by the session. Before Domenico Cannavo, assessore and officer of the civil state by delegation, on 12 July 1866 at 7 in the evening (the day is read from cursive; the act before is 7 July, the act after 21 July). Groom Francesco Mazza, 27, 'industrioso', BORN AT SAPONARA, resident at Giarre, son of PAOLO (bracciale, resident at Giarre) and of Concetta Vuggeri (Ruggeri?), resident at Giarre. Bride Giuseppa Fresta (the cursive reads Fre?ta / Fresa), 21, born at Giarre, daughter of Giuseppe (bordonaro, muleteer) and of the late Pierra (Sierra?) Maccarrone. Witnesses Alfio Vita (50, bordonaro) and Mariano Arcidiacono (46, a secolare). THIS SETTLES THE GIARRE MAZZA HOUSEHOLD: the parents of the births of 1869 (Paolo, died 1872), 1881 (Giuseppe) and 1884 (Rosa) and of the deaths of 1872 and 1879 (Paolo and Alfia): Francesco, born about 1839 at Saponara (father Paolo; the 1869 child Paolo is named for him), married Giuseppa Fresta, born about 1845, in July 1866. Saponara is in the province of Messina, so this Mazza family came to Giarre from the Messina side; no Mazza of Saponara is yet linked to the Piedimonte or Linguaglossa lines. UNCONNECTED; no link is claimed.
